Package grpcdc

Class KafkaNative

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.KafkaNative
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class KafkaNative extends Object implements AutoCloseable
In-process Kafka client via libkafka_native (native only). The collapsed form of the Kafka proxy: the Kafka protocol implementation runs in this process through the kafka-native shared library, instead of in a kafka_proxy sidecar reached over gRPC. Java reaches the C ABI through a small JNI shim (java/jni/kafka_native_jni.c, built into libkafka_native_jni) because JDK 17 has no stable FFI. Method surface mirrors the generated KafkaClient; requests and responses are the same generated message types. Shim location: the GRPC_DC_KAFKA_NATIVE_JNI environment variable (full path), or "kafka_native_jni" on java.library.path.
